title: SCOOP: Allu Arjun's Raaka may release in two parts; Atlee exploring major change to Rs. 800 crore epic
body: Here's the latest box office buzz making the rounds:

" Raaka has been in production for more than a year now, and the footage shot so far has grown far beyond what can realistically be accommodated within a conventional three-hour runtime. With at least four months of filming still pending, it has become practically impossible to fit the complete narrative into one movie," a source associated with the project told Bollywood Hungama . "However, the makers have not yet locked in the two-part concept, as Atlee is still exploring how the story might best be structured, and a definitive decision will be taken only after shooting wraps."

Adding to this, Sources say Allu and the other cast members have complete faith in Atlee's vision to deliver the biggest spectacle possible and are giving him the time required to realize the project's ambitious scope. Allu is believed to have committed his dates through December before he fully dives into Lokesh Kanagaraj's superhero movie early next year. The principal production of this large-scale, VFX-heavy pan-India movie is expected to continue until the first quarter of 2027, with the makers targeting a worldwide theatrical rollout in the latter half of 2027.

Meanwhile, Sun Pictures, which is producing the movie on a staggering budget of Rs. 800 crore rupees, is shared to be pushing for a two-part format; however, the final call rests with Atlee. The producers are arguing that the split would not only offer greater creative freedom to tell the story as Atlee has envisioned it but would also improve its financial viability, reducing the recovery pressure associated with the movie. However, the strategy is not without risk, as the success of the second part depends heavily on the audience's response to the first movie.

Notably, A similar approach was of late adopted by Aditya Dhar and Ranveer Singh's Dhurandhar . The movie was initially supposed to be a single, action-heavy espionage thriller but was later split into two parts just a few months before its rollout after the makers realized that its nearly seven hours of footage could not be justified within a standard three-hour movie. Backed by Jio Studios, the gamble paid off handsomely, and the movie turned out to be a bona fide historic smash hit, with both instalments collectively earning Rs. 2,004 crore rupees net in India and Rs. 3,203 crore rupees globally.

As per the latest buzz, Raaka is being positioned as a visual spectacle that pushes the boundaries of Indian cinema through advanced visual effects and high-concept world-building. Atlee is shared to be leaving no stone unturned to deliver a memorable theatrical experience. Anchored by a star-studded pan-India ensemble that includes Deepika Padukone, Mrunal Thakur, Rashmika Mandanna, and Janhvi Kapoor alongside Allu Arjun, the project is shaping up to be one of the most ambitious theatrical events of 2027.

title: Ramayana faces fresh controversy as Shri Ramlila Mahasangh seeks preview screening, warns of protests over alleged inaccuracies
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
President Arjun Kumar has urged the makers of the movie to hold a special screening before rollout, citing concerns over scenes that could hurt religious sentiments.

Adding to this, During a recent press conference, Kumar opened up that he has written a formal letter to the filmmakers requesting an advance screening of Ramayana . According to him, the demand stems from concerns that certain portions of the movie could potentially hurt the religious sentiments of Hindus in India and abroad.

Meanwhile, In conversation with PTI, Kumar maintained that the Mahasangh supports the rollout of the movie but wants to ensure that it preserves the sanctity of the epic. He shared, "We welcome this movie and encourage millions of people to watch it. We will even arrange free screenings for members of the Ramleela Committee. However, the trailer caused us some distress as it lacked the appropriate sentiment that should have been present. The costumes appeared rather odd and this prompted us to urge the producers and directors to screen the movie for the Ramleela Committee before its rollout.”

Notably, He continued, “If any shortcomings are found, we can offer our input and we would certainly welcome the movie. However, if the movie is rolled out without such a screening much like 'Adipurush' and ends up hurting religious sentiments, we warn that we will not allow it to run. We have made this declaration in consultation with the Ramleela Mahasangh and Delhi's Ramlila committees that our religious sentiments must not be offended."

As per the latest buzz, Referring to the backlash faced by Adipurush , Kumar shared that inaccuracies in the adaptation had led to widespread criticism. One of the major objections raised against the 2023 movie was its depiction of Lanka in black instead of the traditionally described golden kingdom, among other creative liberties that many believed deviated from the original epic. Kumar suggested that such deviations contributed to the movie's poor reception at the ticket-window.

In further updates, Apart from concerns arising from the trailer, Kumar also claimed that the organisation had received information suggesting that certain portions of Ramayana could prove objectionable to audiences, although he did not specify the scenes in question. “According to information received by the Mahasangh, Ramayana may also contain certain scenes that could hurt the sentiments of Hindus living in India and abroad. In light of this, the organisation has requested a special preview screening to ensure that any potentially objectionable scenes or dialogues are identified and removed prior to rollout."

On top of that, The Shri Ramlila Mahasangh President has also as per reports warned that if the filmmakers do not agree to their request for a preview screening and if the movie is found to contain inaccuracies, the organisation will stage protests and demonstrations outside cinema halls across various cities during its rollout.

Meanwhile, Ramayana remains one of the most anticipated Indian films in recent years. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the epic stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita Maa, Ravie Dubey as Lakshman, Sunny Deol as Lord Hanuman, Rakul Preet Singh as Surpanakha, Lara Dutta as Kaikeyi, while producer Yash also essays the role of Ravana.

In further updates, Guru Randhawa's contribution is part of a broader nationwide effort to support Assam's flood-hit communities. title: Violinist and composer L Subramaniam: A road in father’s name in Sri Lanka is a tribute to his musical legacy
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Padma Vibhushan violinist-composer L Subramaniam was of late conferred Sri Lanka’s Highest State Tribute and the Violin Maestro Lakshminarayana Road was inaugurated in Jaffna in memory of his legendary father Vaidyanatha Lakshminarayana.

Adding to this, Violinist L Subramaniam with wife-singer singer Kavita Krishnamurthy during the inauguration of Violin Maestro Lakshminarayana Road, named in memory of his father Vaidyanatha Lakshminarayana in Jaffna, Sri Lanka He tells HT City, “I’m so happy that my father’s legacy continues. It’s a recognition to not only him but also to the violin which he transformed from a just accompanying status to a major solo instrumentalist today. He lived in Sri Lanka in the ’30s to ’50 and all the transformation happened for him living there where he developed the techniques and subsequently, he taught us (siblings) when we lived there.”
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by L Subramaniam (@drlsubramaniam)

Notably, To honour him, they named the street as Violin Maestro Lakshminarayana Road next to the Ramanathan College where he taught, and just across is culture centre North Ceylon Sangeetha Sabha in Jaffna. He inaugurated the road in presence of his wife and singer Kavita Krishnamurthy and Sri Lankan officials.
As per the latest buzz, Subramaniam was also awarded the state honour by their culture minister in Colombo.

In further updates, “It was a very nostalgic moment for me as it was at Nallur Kandaswamy Devasthanam temple in Jaffna I gave my first stage performance as a six-year-old. So, before the road’s inauguration, I went to perform at the temple and took blessings from Lord Murugan,” he says.

On top of that, On his father’s connection with the island, he says, “In 1935 he went to teach at Ramanathan College in Jaffna. In 1953, Radio Ceylon in Colombo invited him to head the instrumental section and create a solid broadcasting system for classical music. He returned in 1958 when problems and unrest started on the island.”

He adds, "His vision was to transform it into a global solo instrument so the Indian violinists can also go and play in Carnegie Hall, Lincoln Center, and Royal Albert Hall as a solo player, which never happened before he dreamt about it. He developed a lot of techniques sitting in Sri Lanka."

title: Ramanand Sagar's grandson reviews Ramayana trailer, objects to Ranbir Kapoor's casting: ‘He has baggage after Animal'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It is hard to match the legacy of legendary director and producer Ramanand Sagar , who created the iconic 1987 television series Ramayan. However, Ranbir Kapoor -starrer Ramayana has been creating significant buzz ever since its trailer was rolled out. Now, Ramanand's grandson, Shiv Sagar, has shared his review of the movie's trailer.

Adding to this, Star Ranbir Kapoor is portraying Ram in the movie Ramayana 'Didn't care for other actors apart from Yash' While Shiv lauded the movie's VFX and appreciated the casting of Sai Pallavi and Yash, he was critical of Ranbir Kapoor's casting as Lord Ram.

Meanwhile, In the clip posted by Tooth Mountain Farms that is now going widely shared, Shiv shared, "I saw the trailer, and of course, the trailer was much better than the promo because the teaser that they had put out before had very little information. In the trailer, we could see more of the characters and more of the VFX, and also they revealed Ravan, which is played by Yash."

Notably, Praising Yash and Sai Pallavi's casting as Ravana and Sita, he shared, “Overall, I really like the casting of Yash as Ravan and Sai Pallavi as Sita because they are from South, and these actors from South, they really understand our mythology, and these are stories told to them from a very young age by their grandparents. So they really know the mannerisms, and they know these characters very well, and I think that is why Yash and Sai Pallavi were really able to incorporate these characters into their acting, but I did not care much for the other actors.”
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Tooth Mountain Farms (@toothmountainfarms)

In further updates, Criticising Ranbir's casting as Lord Ram, he shared, "Because typically, what we do is, we cast a fresh face for a character like Ram because Ranbir has a lot of baggage with him, especially after Animal. I really don’t know if he will be accepted as Ram, but the VFX was very good. Nitish Tiwari ji has conceptualised the thing very beautifully."

On top of that, Shiv went on to praise the concept of Ravana's Pushpak Vimana and Surpanakha arriving on a lion chariot. He also expressed hope that the movie performs well, saying it could encourage younger audiences to take an interest in Indian mythology.

Ramayana is an soon-to-release mythological epic directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra. The movie features a star-studded cast including Ranbir Kapoor, Sai Pallavi, Yash, Sunny Deol, Ravie Dubey, Rakul Preet Singh and others. The movie's Part 1 is slated for rollout during Diwali 2026, with Part 2 scheduled to arrive in 2027. title: Delhi Ramlila demands screening of Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana before release, warns protests otherwise
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Nitish Tiwari’s directorial Ramayana , starring Ranbir Kapoor , has landed in a row after its trailer was rolled out of late.

Adding to this, Star Ranbir Kapoor is portraying Ram in the movie Ramayana Arjun Kumar, president of Shri Ramlila Mahasangh and Lav Kush Ramlila, Old Delhi, has written a letter to the makers for a special screening before its theatrical rollout. It shared the demand is to ensure that no scenes or dialogues hurt religious sentiments and they warned of protests if its request is not considered.
Meanwhile, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Namit Malhotra (@iamnamitmalhotra)

Notably, He added, “We have been staging Ramayana for around 50 years now and do not feel the dresses used in the movie’s trailer are suitable to portray Ramayana characters. We have objections to all these things that could be rejected by the viewers after the movie releases.”

As per the latest buzz, He also gave the example of Adipurush (2023), which Prabhas promoted in their Ramlila, but later there were major objections over Mughal-era figures, costume, and portrayal of Lanka.

In further updates, “Our reason to ask the makers to show us the movie before releasing is when the movie Baahubali came out of late, Prabhas was its star and the worship of Lord Shiva in it was done in such a way that it was lauded by everyone. After that, Prabas's Adipurush came and we invited him to promote the movie at our Ramlila at Red Fort grounds, thinking that the movie will be a very beautiful picture of Adipurush Lord Ram,” he clarified.
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Namit Malhotra (@iamnamitmalhotra)

On problems that started after the rollout, he says, “The movie showed golden Lanka as black Lanka made of coal and even the Ramayana were dressed in costumes that apparently used leather like how the Mughals wore. That hurt people's sentiments and hence the picture flopped even though it was a mega budget movie.”

title: Imtiaz Ali and Anurag Kashyap reunite to present coming of age short Bobby Beauty Parlour during Friendship Week
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The nostalgic short movie, directed by Shashwat Dwivedi, premieres on August 6 on the Oh Short Flips YouTube channel with a story celebrating different emotions.

Adding to this, Directed by Shashwat Dwivedi, Bobby Beauty Parlour tells the story of childhood best friends Eelu and Manu, who spend one final afternoon together before life takes them in different directions. Set largely inside a neighbourhood beauty parlour, the short captures the innocence of adolescence as the duo spend their time drinking, napping, arguing, and trying to hold on to a friendship that is about to change forever.

Meanwhile, The collaboration also marks a rare creative coming together between Imtiaz Ali and Anurag Kashyap, whose friendship dates back to their university days in Delhi. While Kashyap has been curating content for the Oh Short Flips YouTube channel, Bobby Beauty Parlour has been backed by producer Ranjan Singh and curated by the filmmaker.

Notably, Sharing his thoughts on the movie, Imtiaz Ali shared, “The most spectacular moments of life don’t scream, but remain a part of our character forever. It is such moments that make Bobby Beauty Parlour charming. The movie got me remembering my own small hometown, my adolescent decisions and friends that I always carried with me.”

As per the latest buzz, The short has been produced by Janhavi Asthana, who has also co-written and served as the cinematographer for the movie, alongside Ranjan Singh and Anurag Kashyap. The cast features Adrija Sinha, Parul Rana, Saksham Raj, and Preeti Kochar.

In further updates, Speaking about the project, Anurag Kashyap described it as a heartfelt coming-of-age tale. “About friendship, aspirations and growing up. And the best part is the producer Janhavi is also the co-writer and shot the movie. Director Shashwat, is someone that started out with me whose growth has been so much and feels so personal.”

On top of that, Producer Ranjan Singh highlighted the movie's successful festival run and its timely rollout during Friendship Week. “ Bobby Beauty Parlour is an acclaimed short which has travelled to many festivals across the world. Essentially a heart-warming story about friends, life and its realities, it fits perfectly for a friendship week rollout.”

Director Shashwat Dwivedi expressed his excitement about the movie reaching audiences through YouTube while reflecting on the personal significance of the collaboration. “ Bobby Beauty Parlour has been an amazing experience for me, especially because of the people involved it in. I'm glad the movie is releasing on YouTube, given I've learnt so much of my filmmaking through the platform, it feels good to give something back for a change. It's also tough to believe that two of my favourite movie makers are presenting the movie, both of whom have had a great impact on my life. I really hope it reaches a wide audience and people start missing their friends after watching it,” he added.

title: Bhumi Pednekar condemns rape threats against female protesters in new video; internet calls it 'damage control'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After facing backlash for calling out protesters for using foul language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi, Bhumi Pednekar has shared another video in which she speaks out against online bullying targeting a female protester whose video of late went widely shared. The star condemned the rape and death threats being directed at the young woman and other female protesters.

Adding to this, Bhumi Pednekar shared a new video slamming rape threats against female protester. What did Bhumi Pednekar say? In the video, Bhumi says, "I saw a video on the Internet, in which a young girl who was part of the protest was giving an interview, and she looked visibly broken and shaken. Her one video had went widely shared, and since then she has been receiving rape and death threats, even her mother faced the same. This is unacceptable. We cannot bully a young girl. We cannot put fear psychosis in a young child’s mind just because we don’t agree with their opinion."

Meanwhile, She added, "As women we anyway face a lot of harassment and as a public figure, I have gone through that experience and I cannot tell you how deep and lasting its impact is on someone’s mental health. We all just want the nation to progress and when we will demand right things, in the right way with unity, we will see right development. I just wanted to leave this thought."
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Bhumi Satish Pednekkar (@bhumisatishpednekkar)

As per the latest buzz, Many social media users are calling Bhumi's latest video a "damage control" move following the criticism over her earlier remarks. One comment read, "Nice damage control." Another comment read, "Didi, just realised that she might her lose audience 😶." One more comment read, "This one should have been your 1st video. Now it feels like damage control."

In further updates, In her earlier video, Bhumi had criticised protesters for using abusive language against Prime Minister Narendra Modi. Her remarks prompted many on social media to question what they described as her selective outrage, with several users pointing out that the star had not supported the student-led CJP protest in Delhi but decided to school protestors about their behaviour.

On top of that, Bhumi had shared in the clip, "Looking at the videos surfacing now, the kind of language being used, and the way the youth of our country are speaking — the youth of our country... this isn't how we talk, man. We are talking about someone who holds the highest office in the land today. And it’s not just about the office; would we ever speak like this to the elders in our own homes? Can we really resort to using abusive language?”

She added, "Guys, this isn't our culture; it’s wrong, and this really bothered me — that’s why I wanted to come forward and address this: a country will only progress and move forward when, collectively and unitedly, we discuss our flaws as well as the good things. Our culture and value system form our backbone; we shouldn't stray from them, otherwise, we won't be able to communicate the right things in the right way, and they will never be implemented or lead to change."

title: Salman Khan makes rare comment about his time in jail: ‘We had bars, in a small area there were 60-70 people’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Bollywood star Sohail Khan is currently a contestant on the reality show Alliance. After facing a tough week, Sohail's brother, star Salman Khan was seen entering the show to show support for him in the house. In the latest promo, Salman got candid about his time in jail and spoke about the living conditions inside the jail.

Adding to this, Salman Khan went to jail on four separate occasions related to the 1998 blackbuck and chinkara poaching cases. What Salman Khan shared Salman shared, “Bohot saalon pehle jab jail gaya tha toh [Many years ago when I was in jail] we had bars infront of us. In such a small area, there are 50-60-70 people there… one bathroom, Indian-style commode, kabhi chhipkali hain [there were lizards] and more than that ***t is filled all the way till here [hand gesture to show high up].”

Meanwhile, Salman has been sent to jail or custody 4 times totaling roughly 18 days of imprisonment, primarily due to the 1998 blackbuck and chinkara poaching cases. Talking about his previous jail terms, Salman had told Koel Puri in an interview in 2008 that he was “chilling” and “the only tension was bathroom”. “I was blank. I was chilling. The only tension was the bathroom. That was it. [pause] And, the bin, and three, four times I have gone in and out of it. If someone wants to put you in, you go in quietly. When you know you haven’t done it, you go in head high,” he shared in the 2008 episode of On the Couch with Koel.

Notably, Earlier on Alliance, Sohail had made an emotional confession. Sohail recalled being sexually harassed as a child and opened up that he did not tell anyone about the incident until he became an adult. Sohail shared, "I was sexually harassed by somebody when I was young and I kept that within me for years. When I grew up and became an adult, I confided in my father. I told him, 'Daddy, this happened to me.' He shared, 'Beta, tune itne saalon tak apne andar rakha isse (Son, you kept this inside you for so many years).' I shared, 'I am so sorry, but I was so embarrassed to say it.' I was not at fault, but I felt ashamed. So I keep telling my children, no matter what happens, tell me everything."

As per the latest buzz, Alliance is a reality competition series that premiered on Prime Video in 2026 and is hosted by star Kunal Kemmu . The show features star contestants from the worlds of television, films, digital content and sports, who compete in physically and mentally demanding challenges while forming and breaking alliances in a bid to survive the game. It is available to stream on Amazon Prime Video.

title: Kangana Ranaut defends viral 2018 Cannes party clip: ‘I was a moderate Hindu, mujhe Sanghi banna hai’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

After targeting Sonakshi Sinha in a cryptic Instagram post, Kangana Ranaut has now shared a video defending her old widely shared clip from the 2018 Cannes after-party, in which she is seen dancing her heart out. The star insisted that while she was once a "moderate Hindu", she now considers herself an "awakened Hindu."

Adding to this, Kangana Ranaut addressed criticism for her political views. (PTI) 'Mujhe Sanghi banna hai' Kangana addressed the criticism and trolling she has faced over changing her political and religious views and embracing what she described as becoming an "awakened Hindu."

Meanwhile, She shared in the clip, “Jab Hindu betiyon ki baat aati hai, main apne aap ko defend nahi karungi ki maine item songs ke khilaaf, pay parity ke khilaaf ya kabhi badi-badi filmon mein kaam nahi kiya hai. Heroes ke khilaaf bahishkar kiya, nepotism ke khilaaf ladai, mujhe aisa kaise keh sakte hain? Haan, main ek moderate Hindu thi. Aaj agar maine khud ko defend kar liya toh na jaane kitni betiyaan jo ye leap nahi le paayengi. Mujhe taane kaste hain, ‘Tum kab se Sanghi ban gayi?’ Mujhe Sanghi banna hai. Mujhe BJP, RSS ki ideology, ‘awakened Hindu’, mujhe woh banna hai. Mujhe convert hona hai. Why can't I do that,” she added.

Notably, It translates to, "When it comes to Hindu daughters, I won't defend myself by saying I didn't speak out against item songs or the lack of pay parity, or that I didn't work in big films. I boycotted male stars and fought against nepotism— how can anyone say such things about me? Yes, I used to be a moderate Hindu. If I were to defend myself today, who knows how many daughters might fail to take this leap? People taunt me, asking, "Since when did you become a Sanghi?" I want to be a Sanghi. I want to embrace the ideology of the BJP and RSS — to be an 'awakened Hindu.' I want to convert. Why can't I do that?"
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kangana Ranaut (@kanganaranaut)

In further updates, Kangana also addressed her old widely shared video from the 2018 Cannes after-party, which has resurfaced online. She shared, "This double standards that the society has that when it is about Hindu daughters, they will ask questions like 'You used to party and all that.' I agree, I used to do all that but today I also want to convert and become a defined and awakened Hindu. Why is that path closed for me? So these double standards won't work. Our daughters should have the choice to convert to defined, disciplined Hindu."
On top of that, View this post on Instagram A post shared by B O L L Y W O O D (@filmyselfies.official)

Earlier today, Kangana shared a cryptic post that many believed was aimed at Sonakshi Sinha. She wrote, "There are many fake news that are doing rounds, this like of mine is also fake I never body shame anyone but I have noticed an star who dresses and speaks like a pocket maar these days she wears half pants and ulta cap and talks like a jebkatra while passionately promoting gutterchap behaviour of protestors. I always feel how you dress in a relationship is a direct reflection of how you feel, dear fellow star if your man is making you feel like a jebkatra I am sorry, you used to dress and speak so elegantly what happened to you? Opinions are yours but you can do better with that styling of yours if you need some help I am always there for you 😘."

title: EXCLUSIVE: Farhan Akhtar exits Aamir Khan-Ashutosh Gowariker's Lalkaara; Sidhant Gupta steps in
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Farhan is believed to have opted out of the sports drama due to scheduling conflicts with his soon-to-release Neeraj Pandey movie on the life of R.D. Burman. The star will have to undergo extensive preparation to play the legendary music composer in Pandey's movie and will need to dedicate himself entirely to the project until shooting is completed. Considering Ashutosh Gowariker's movie also required him to undergo months of cricket training and commit to a lengthy shooting schedule, Farhan chose to prioritize the R.D. Burman biopic and amicably stepped away from the sports drama.

Adding to this, However, Farhan remains associated with the movie as a producer. He and Ritesh Sidhwani are producing it under their Excel Entertainment banner in association with Rajkumar Hirani Films. Furthermore, Farhan's exit has not made much difference to the movie's proposed production timeline, as the makers have already finalized his replacement, Sidhant Gupta. The star is best known for his performances in shows like Inside Edge , Jubilee , Black Warrant , and Freedom at Midnight , and will play one of Aamir Khan's friends in the movie.

Meanwhile, Described as an ambitious sports saga based on the historic 1952 India-Pakistan Test series, Lalkaara marks Aamir and Ashutosh Gowariker's much-awaited reunion following their 2001 classic Lagaan . Written by Piyush Gupta ( Dangal , Chhichhore ) and Neeraj Singh ( Nil Battey Sannata ), the movie explores themes of friendship, intense rivalry, and national pride against the backdrop of one of Indian cricket's most significant chapters. Aamir will play the role of cricketing legend Lala Amarnath, independent India's first cricket captain, who led the Indian team during the first-ever Test series between India and Pakistan after Partition. Shooting is scheduled to begin on October 1 in Mumbai.

title: ‘Jugni’ singer Sonu Thukral files police complaint against AI-edited Jacqueline Fernandez ‘wardrobe malfunction’ video
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Sonu, who has lent his voice to ‘ Jugni ’ alongside singer B Praak, filed a police complaint on Friday, claiming that the widely shared video is an AI-generated edit. Sharing an update on Instagram, the singer posted a photograph of himself with a police officer while holding a copy of the complaint.

Adding to this, In the caption, Sonu wrote, “I have filed a police complaint regarding my song ‘ Jugni ’. The clip has also been edited using AI, and the AI-generated version of the clip is being circulated further. I will talk about it publicly soon.”
Meanwhile, As of now, Jacqueline Fernandez and the other members associated with the music video have not rolled out any official statement regarding the allegations.

Notably, The issue has sparked widespread discussion on social media, with several users calling for a thorough investigation into the claims. One user commented, “The seriousness of Sonu Thukral's allegations should be thoroughly investigated, and if the allegations are found to be true, the person who made the AI-edited video should be caught as soon as possible.” Another wrote, “15 days ago, Sonu Thukral's music video ‘ Jugni ’ was rolled out, in which objectionable scenes of Jacqueline were shown. There was opposition to it on social media; people shared good and bad things, but now the truth has come to light. Sonu Thukral has opened up that those scenes were created by someone using AI, for which he has filed a report in cyber crime.”

As per the latest buzz, On the work front, Jacqueline was last seen in Welcome To The Jungle , the multi-starrer headlined by Akshay Kumar. The movie collected Rs.133.98 crore rupees net in India and collected Rs.192.60 crore rupees worldwide despite receiving mixed reviews.

title: Anupam Kher hops on viral 'Mere Mehboob' trend from CJP protest with Boman Irani and Ranvir Shorey
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Anupam Kher has hopped on the widely shared Mere Mehboob Qayamat Hogi trend. The star, along with his Khosla Ka Ghosla co-stars Boman Irani , Ranvir Shorey, and Parvin Dabas, was seen recreating the trend while adding their own hilarious twist to it.

Adding to this, Anupam Kher performs 'Teri Galiyon Mein' trend with Shorey Khosla Ka Ghosla stars. Anupam Kher, Boman Irani hop on ‘Teri Galiyon Mein’ trend Anupam took the trend seriously by dressing up as his iconic character Kamal Kishore Khosla from Khosla Ka Ghosla. In the clip, he stands in front while Boman, Ranvir, and Parvin are seen behind him as they perform the widely shared trend. For followers of the cult classic, it was a nostalgic moment to see Khosla (Anupam) and Khurana (Boman) having fun together, considering the two characters were at loggerheads throughout the movie over a piece of land.

Meanwhile, Anupam captioned the post, "Khoslas and Khurana were never in sync. NOT EVEN HERE! Jai Ho! 😂🤣🤣🤣🤣 #KhoslaKaGhosla2 #Trending #ShootTime." For the unversed, Anupam and the gang will be back with Khosla Ka Ghosla 2. The movie will rollout in theatres on August 28.
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Anupam Kher (@anupampkher)

As per the latest buzz, The ‘Mere Mehboob- Teri Galiyon Mein’ reel trend exploded on the internet after 19-year-old influencer Abhinav Bisht filmed himself dancing to the song with his friends during the CJP-led NEET protest in Delhi. Bisht made several short videos at the protest, but this reel turned into a full-blown internet sensation after it garnered 7.2 million views. He went from having around 3,000 followers to more than 720,000 overnight and currently has over 912,000 followers on Instagram. Bisht's Instagram account was also suspended for a brief period before being restored.

In further updates, During the CJP protest, Anupam had supported the students in their demand for the resignation of Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. However, he had also warned them against allowing their protest to be hijacked by external groups, particularly political parties.

On top of that, He shared, "I want to say this thing as a big brother to you all, when external parties start entering your protest, especially political parties, who want to register their presence in every protest. Their aim is not to advance your cause, but to fulfil their own vested interests. You should be careful in this case. You might feel in the beginning that the more people join you, your protest will get more powerful, but it is not like that always. Many times, these same people start using your voices; they are just there to serve their political agendas. Later, the cause doesn’t remain with you; they take away the cameras and slogans with them. In this case, you and your protest suffer your truth suffers."

Vibha Maru is an Assistant Editor with Hindustan Times Entertainment, based in Delhi. With a decade of experience across digital and print media, she covers Bollywood, Hollywood and web shows. title: Raj Thackeray takes swipe at Vivek Oberoi, R Madhavan over living in Dubai despite praising India: “Why live in Dubai if you love India?”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Referring to Vivek Oberoi, who portrayed Prime Minister Narendra Modi in the 2019 biographical movie based on the PM, Thackeray remarked, “Vivek Oberoi, who made a movie on Modi and played Modi's role in it, has also gone to live in Dubai.”

Adding to this, He also questioned R. Madhavan's decision to reside in Dubai and shared, “R Madhavan who lauded PM Modi - where does he live? He lives in Dubai. So if you love India so much, if you love PM Modi, if they believe that PM Modi is developing India, then why are they living in a foreign land? Why are they living in Dubai with their families?” Thackeray further alleged, “They will come here, work in a government-sponsored movie like Dhurandhar and then will go back to Dubai.”

Meanwhile, Madhavan has previously shared that he relocated to Dubai during the COVID-19 pandemic to support his son's swimming career, while Vivek Oberoi has shared he moved there to expand his business interests.

Notably, During the same address, Thackeray also spoke about the language used against Prime Minister Modi during the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) protests at Delhi's Jantar Mantar. Referring to the Prime Minister's response that such "misguided children" should be forgiven and guided, Thackeray shared, “I agree with it (PM's statement). No one should use a language of such a low level. But he should tell people of his own party.”

As per the latest buzz, He alleged that BJP troll groups frequently target public figures, including Mahatma Gandhi, Jawaharlal Nehru, Indira Gandhi, and members of the Thackeray family. According to him, several actors now avoid expressing their opinions publicly because of online trolling. Thackeray added that abusive language should not be used against anyone and remarked, “Even they (BJP supporters) should be asked to stop (from using derogatory language). BJP troll teams started this. As you sow, so shall you reap.”
In further updates, He also shared the NEET paper leak row may have sparked the CJP protests, but the large public participation reflected accumulated grievances built up over the years.

title: No change in King’s release date; Shah Rukh Khan ALL SET to take on Avengers: Doomsday, Jumanji: Open World and Dune: Part Three this December
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:

Significantly, King will arrive amid three major Hollywood releases. December 18 will witness the epic clash between Avengers: Doomsday and Dune: Part Three . Among the Hollywood releases, Avengers: Doomsday will pose the strongest competition, as the franchise is now one of the biggest in India. Internationally, however, all three Hollywood films are major releases with smash hit potential. This is where King could face some challenges in securing an adequate number of screens.”

As per the latest buzz, The trade source continued, “However, only a movie of King’s calibre can take on such Hollywood giants. Shah Rukh Khan is the biggest Indian star overseas. Moreover, Yash Raj Films is distributing King in international markets. They will surely leverage their years of experience and goodwill to secure the best possible screens and show timings.”

This will be followed by major releases such as Spirit on March 5 and Varanasi on April 7. By arriving during Christmas, King may initially face some screen-sharing issues. On the positive side, however, it won’t face any fresh competition until Republic Day. If the word of mouth is as strong as expected, the sky is the limit for the movie.”

On top of that, One section of the exhibition ecosystem that remains concerned is the single-screen sector. title: 'Ranbir Kapoor's Lord Ram seems weak': Ramlila body demands pre-release screening of Ramayana, warns of protests
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Ranbir Kapoor's Ramayana is one of the most anticipated films of the year. However, before its grand rollout on Diwali this year, the movie has landed in row. Arjun Kumar, President of Shri Ramlila Mahasangh, has written a formal letter to the movie's makers requesting a special screening before its theatrical rollout. The organisation has demanded the screening to ensure that no scenes or dialogues hurt religious sentiments. It has also warned of protests if its request is not considered.

Adding to this, Ranbir Kapoor plays Lord Rama in Ramayana. 'Ranbir doesn't fully resemble the image of Lord Ram' Kumar shared that the screening should be arranged for members of the Mahasangh, Ramlila committees, and Hindu organisations in Delhi. In conversation with the media in Delhi, Kumar described Ranbir's portrayal of Lord Ram as 'weak'.

Meanwhile, The press note read, "...Of late, a movie starring Prabhas was rolled out, and we even organised a promotional event for it at the Red Fort...However, the movie contained objectionable content. For example, the golden city of Lanka was depicted as black, leather was used inappropriately, and some characters were portrayed with features resembling Mughal-era figures...In our view, Adipurush presented a negative image, which is why that mega-budget movie failed at the ticket-window."

Notably, He added, "As for the soon-to-release movie starring Ranbir Kapoor, we are ready to welcome and promote it. The Ramlila Committee even plans to arrange free screenings for thousands of people. However, we have one request for the filmmakers. The of late rolled out trailer for the Ramayana adaptation appears underwhelming. Ranbir Kapoor's portrayal of Lord Ram seems weak and lacks the gravitas associated with the character."

As per the latest buzz, Among the concerns raised was teh depiction of Lanka. “The depiction of Lanka in black instead of gold, and the portrayal of Ravana and his army in a manner that did not align with traditional beliefs," as per the press note

In further updates, He further shared, "In our opinion, he does not fully resemble the image of Lord Ram...In contrast, regarding this new mega-budget movie starring a major star like Ranbir Kapoor, our only request is that it should avoid the kind of scenes that appeared in Adipurush and contributed to its failure...We would like a show of the movie to be arranged for Hindu organisations in Delhi, including the Ramlila committees."

On top of that, The organisation also warned that if the filmmakers do not arrange the requested screening, Shri Ramlila Mahasangh, along with various Hindu organisations, will stage protests and demonstrations outside cinema halls in Delhi and other states.

"If any concerns arise during the screening, we would request that the filmmakers consider making the necessary corrections. If they choose not to arrange such a screening, there is little we can do. We are not the certifying authority, but we will certainly raise objections if we believe the movie distorts the scriptures," he concluded.

body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

We can smell a fresh battle brewing soon between actors Kangana Ranaut and Sonakshi Sinha after the former's latest cryptic post. Kangana posted on Instagram to clear the air about an apparent 'like' on a post about a ‘moti (fat woman)’ not talking about Jharkhand paper leak row after being vocal about the NEET paper leak protests last month.

Adding to this, Is Kangana Ranaut's latest post about Sonakshi Sinha? What did Kangana Ranaut say? Kangana shared that the screenshot of her ‘like’ on the post was fake and that she would not body shame anyone like that. However, her own words on the unnamed star were hardly any kinder.

Meanwhile, She wrote in her Instagram story: 'There are many fake news that are doing rounds, this like of mine is also fake I never body shame anyone but I have noticed an star who dresses and speaks like a pocket maar these days she wears half pants and ulta cap and talks like a jebkatra while passionately promoting gutterchap behaviour of protestors. I always feel how you dress in a relationship is a direct reflection of how you feel, dear fellow star if your man is making you feel like a jebkatra I am sorry, you used to dress and speak so elegantly what happened to you? Opinions are yours but you can do better with that styling of yours if you need some help I am always there for you 😘."

Notably, Social media has been buzzing, trying to decode who she was speaking about and everyone's first guess is Sonakshi Sinha. She was among the first Bollywood celebrities to speak about the student protests at Jantar Mantar in Delhi in July. She also posted a video in a T-shirt, shorts and a cap, celebrating the students victory when education minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned.

In further updates, "I've never made a public statement like this before, but I can't stay silent any longer. We all know Sonam Wangchuk. We know what he has done for the country, his achievements, and the many honours he has received.

On top of that, "For the past 18 days, he has been on a hunger strike without food. And why? Because he is fighting for the future of children, a future he believes is being pushed towards ruin," the star.

This comes days after Kangana and Hrithik Roshan reignited their old feud. Roshan of late reacted to a post on Instagram, which read "We need to apologise to Hrithik Roshan". title: Pranit More fights back tears during first live show after ₹370 biryani row: ‘Log mujhe accept karenge?’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Comedian Pranit More faced a difficult time after receiving severe backlash in June 2026 over the widely shared ₹ 370 biryani"> ₹ 370 biryani row, which stemmed from an audience member's inappropriate remarks about his dating experience during one of More's crowd-work sets. The comedian performed his first live show after the row, and a leaked clip from the performance has now gone widely shared. The video shows Pranit fighting tears on stage.

Adding to this, Pranit More faced backlash after ₹370 biryani row. 'Will people accept me?' It is reported that the clip is from Pranit's show in Georgia, which took place on June 14, 2026, just days after the row erupted. In the video, Pranit expressed doubt about whether the audience would accept him after the backlash. He also thanked those who continued to support him despite the row.

Meanwhile, He shared, "Jab main stage pe aaya to mujhe laga ki kya ye log mujhe accept karenge. Mujhe bohot hi accha laga ki tum log bohot supportive the jo bhi cheezein huin uske baad bhi (When I came on stage, I wondered if these people would accept me. I felt really good that you all were so supportive, even after everything that happened). So, thanks a lot."

Notably, "Itni saari cheezein ho gayin. Dekho maine standup chalu hi isliye nahi kiya tha ki paise aayenge ya famous hone ke liye. Main jo job karta tha uske baad main standup me aaya kyunki isse mujhe khushi milti hai. Aur humesha point ye tha ki baaki logo ko bhi khushi mile. Aur ye jab nahi hota to thoda bura to lagta hai (So many things happened. Look, I didn't start doing stand-up for money or to become famous. After the job I used to do, I got into stand-up because it brought me joy. And the point was always to bring joy to other people as well. So when that doesn't happen, it does hurt a bit)," More added.

As per the latest buzz, Recalling his mother's advice, he shared, "Meri mummy be mujhe ek hi cheez boli ki 'Tune galti ki aur sorry bol diya. Tere behaviour se dikh jaega'. Main bola 'Agar unhe nahi pasand aaya to'. Mummy ne bola 'Galti to sabhi karte hain. Tum me se aisa koi jisne kabhi galti nahi ki hai. To fir main ye nahin karunga bhai (My mom told me just one thing: 'You made a mistake and apologised. Your behaviour will show it.' I asked, 'What if they still don't like it?' Mom shared, 'Everyone makes mistakes. Is there anyone among you who has never made a mistake?' So then I won't do this, brother)."

In further updates, While thanking the audience, More got emotional once again. "So thanks a lot mujhe fir se chance dene ke liye. Bohot show kiye hain maine. Ye show aur tum log mujhe humesha yaad rahoge (So thank you so much for giving me another chance. I have done a lot of shows, but I will always remember this show and all of you)," he concluded.

On top of that, The row erupted after a clip from one of Pranit's crowd-work sets went widely shared, in which an audience member implied that spending ₹ 370 on chicken biryani during a date entitled him to physical intimacy. The remark sparked outrage online, with many criticising Pranit for not calling out the deeply misogynistic comment during the show.

title: Bhumi Pednekar faces online backlash after calling out protesters for abusing PM Modi: ‘What about police violence?’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Bhumi Pednekar has stirred row by responding to the insulting language directed at Prime Minister Narendra Modi during the NEET-UG 2026 protests that took place for over a month at Jantar Mantar in New Delhi. The star posted on Instagram to advise the youth to show their rage without using insulting language, which she says doesn't represent the country’s culture. But, the internet was quick to point out that she didn't speak about the students being beaten up, lathi-charged, pelted guns being used at them during the Sansad March on July 20. The star is now facing a wave of criticism online, with many calling her comments selective and out of touch.

Adding to this, Bhumi Pednekar faces backlash after 'This isn't our culture' remark on PM Modi criticism during NEET protests. What Bhumi Pednekar shared Taking to Instagram, the star posted a video where she expressed her concern over the abusive language used in some of the widely shared protest videos, especially against PM Narendra Modi, who she shared is at the higher office. She noted that this kind of behaviour is not an expression of India's ideals, and she asked the youth to communicate courteously even as they express their disapproval.

Meanwhile, “Looking at the videos surfacing now, the kind of language being used, and the way the youth of our country are speaking — the youth of our country... this isn't how we talk, man. We are talking about someone who holds the highest office in the land today,” she shared in the video.

Notably, View this post on Instagram Bhumi further equated this issue with how people interact with their elders within their own family. She asked if the use of foul language was at all to be brought into public discourse and highlighted how culture was one of India’s greatest assets. She shared, “Would we ever speak like this to the elders in our own homes? Can we really resort to using abusive language?”

As per the latest buzz, She added that if people move away from those values, meaningful conversations and progress become difficult. Ending her message, she appealed for unity and also spoke about addressing important issues such as gender-based violence and education with dignity. She added, “We need to move forward together in unity.”

In further updates, Bhumi's video quickly attracted criticism, with many users arguing that she addressed the protesters' language but did not speak about the police action that injured several students.

On top of that, One user wrote on Instagram, “Would you rather have someone say one cuss word at you or shoot an AK47 at you? It’s bold of you to condemn someone’s language while not condemning the disproportionate violence they had to face”.

Another commented, “Would love to see you speak up when such language is used by our ministers too”. A third user shared, “Respect cannot be demanded Bhumi!! It’s collected,” while another remarked, “Sitting in AC cars and full on makeup ….very easy to give gyan”.

title: Before Shah Rukh Khan, Sudesh Berry had signed Darr? Actor reveals why Yash Chopra changed his mind
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

It is unimaginable today how the role of the menacing Rahul Mehra in Darr could be played by anyone other than Shah Rukh Khan . While it is a fact that the thriller became one of the biggest blockbusters of Bollywood, it was also a movie which gave SRK one of his iconic roles ever. Nevertheless, it has been revealed many years after that star Sudesh Berry had initially been cast in the movie.

Adding to this, Sudesh Berry reveals he was the original choice for Darr before Shah Rukh Khan landed the iconic role. Sudesh Berry says he had almost signed Darr Sudesh Berry, while appearing on the Accompany Akki podcast, opened up that the makers had cast him as Rahul Mehra, the stalker who ends up being completely obsessed with Kiran played by Juhi Chawla. He shared that the movie was at a very advanced stage, with even his costumes prepared, but then something strange happened.

Meanwhile, “I was offered the role in Darr, and even my costumes were ready,” he shared. He explained that the casting of the other lead kept changing during the movie's development. “Initially, it was Rishi Kapoor, then Aamir Khan was considered, and then they finally cast Sunny Deol,” he revealed.

Notably, As per Sudesh Berry, he found out later that Yash Chopra had second thoughts about his decision owing to the climax of the movie. As per him, the director felt that the effect of the final showdown would be reduced if a less known star overpowers a big star like Sunny Deol.

As per the latest buzz, “Towards the end, there's a shot of my character punching the other person. Whoever played the other character, it appeared as if a bigger star was being punched by Sudesh Berry. This is what I heard,” Sudesh recounted, adding that he has never watched the movie to date, adding “Yash ji was a maker too, and makers are always a bit passionate. They are able to make such good movies because of that passion.”

In further updates, Rolled out in 1993, Darr, directed by Yash Chopra, is a psychological thriller that revolves around Rahul Mehra (Shah Rukh Khan), who develops an unhealthy obsession with Kiran (Juhi Chawla). While Kiran is in a relationship with Sunil Malhotra (Sunny Deol), Rahul fails to accept that she has moved on with her life and starts stalking and intimidating her, posing a threat to all those around her.
On top of that, Darr was a huge commercial hit. SRK's dialogue “K-K-K-Kiran” made it one of the most memorable lines in the history of Bollywood.

title: The 10 tallest skyscrapers in the world
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

From the Burj Khalifa to the China Zun, the following are the tallest buildings on the planet according to the Council on Vertical Urbanism, the Chicago-based non-profit organisation that has been setting the criteria for measuring their height since 1996

Adding to this, È il 1996 l’anno in cui il Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH) compila la prima classifica dei grattacieli più alti del mondo. Lo fa per risolvere una questione: sono più alte le Petronas Towers di Kuala Lumpur o la Sears Tower di Chicago? Le torri malesi hanno il tetto più basso, ma presentano delle guglie, mentre la Sears ha “solo” delle antenne. È in questo contesto che l’ente no-profit stabilisce un criterio fondamentale, ancora oggi in vigore: nel calcolo dell’altezza di un grattacielo le guglie contano, mentre antenne, insegne e apparati tecnici no. The Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat (CTBUH) compiled its first ranking of the world’s tallest skyscrapers back in 1996. It did so in order to resolve the issue of whether the Petronas Towers in Kuala Lumpur was taller than the Sears Tower in Chicago or vice versa. The Malaysian towers have a lower roof, but feature spires, whilst the Sears Tower ‘only’ has aerials. This formed the background to the non-profit organisation’s establishment of a fundamental criterion, still in force today - when calculating the height of a skyscraper, spires count, whereas aerials, signs and technical equipment do not. Other rules introduced by the CTBUH stipulate that height is measured from the main pedestrian entrance to the architectural top; that in order to be classified as a building rather than a tower, at least 50 per cent of the height must be occupiable. This criterion, for example, excludes the Tokyo Skytree, which at 634 metres would be third in this ranking, ahead of the Shanghai Tower - it is a telecommunications tower, not a skyscraper. Furthermore, to feature in the ranking, a skyscraper must be complete: the structure must be finished, the cladding complete, and the doors open to the public. The following is therefore a ranking of existing and accessible buildings; construction sites, however advanced, are excluded. The well-known knock-on effect of these criteria is ‘vanity height’ i.e. the portion of a building having no functional purpose, serving only to boost its ranking. The Burj Khalifa boasts 244 metres of this, almost a third of its total height. In October 2025, the CTBUH changed its name to the Council on Vertical Urbanism. The database remains the same – The Skyscraper Centre – and it is still the only source recognised by the industry. Meanwhile, the rankings have come to a standstill. The Burj Khalifa has been number one since January 2010 - sixteen years, the longest supremacy since the days of the Empire State Building. The two buildings expected to overtake it are subject to intermittent construction – the Jeddah Tower, at 1,008 metres, which was halted in 2017 and resumed in 2023; and the Dubai Creek Tower, which has experienced several interruptions. The kilometre remains the dream that architecture has been pursuing for a century, and which remains as yet unfulfilled. The following are the ten tallest buildings in the world according to the non-profit organisation.

Meanwhile, Designed by Adrian Smith for SOM, it is supported by a buttressed core, a concrete spine running through the entire building. Originally intended to be called Burj Dubai - it took its name from the ruler of Abu Dhabi, who stepped in with his own funds when the financial crisis brought construction to a halt.

Notably, The name means ‘independence’, and the 118 storeys are referred to in the name. The faceted façade reflects light in different ways according to the time of day. Designed by Fender Katsalidis, it has stolen the Malaysian record from the Petronas Towers – just a few hundred metres away – which they had held since 1998.

As per the latest buzz, The 120-degree twist running the entire height of the tower is not merely a design feature: it reduces the wind load on the structure by around a quarter. The American firm Gensler has wrapped the tower in a double-skin glass façade, with 270 wind turbines housed in the cavity between the two façades.

In further updates, Designed by the Lebanese firm Dar Al-Handasah, it forms part of the Abraj Al-Bait, a complex of seven towers built adjacent to the Great Mosque. The clock is visible from over 25 kilometres away. The complex accommodates Hajj pilgrims, and it is the tallest skyscraper ever built for an explicitly religious purpose.

On top of that, Four corner columns that taper as they rise. The cladding is made of stainless steel - 1,700 tonnes -designed to withstand Shenzhen’s subtropical humidity. Designed by Kohn Pedersen Fox, it is the tallest building in the ranking to be dedicated entirely to office space.

title: 'House of the Dragon' finally includes a key book detail about Rhaenyra and the Iron Throne
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

In House of the Dragon Season 3, episode 6, Rhaenyra endures yet another rough session of listening to her subjects' petitions. The citizens of King's Landing are worried about rising costs of their basic needs, as well as the lack of protection from the Gold Cloaks. Rhaenyra is unequipped to answer their worries, and as she stews in her discomfort and rising panic, the Iron Throne cuts her finger and draws blood.

Adding to this, Rhaenyra hides her injury, but as she does, she looks towards one of the statues of the Targaryen kings lining the throne room. It's that of her father, Viserys (Paddy Considine), seen holding what looks like a model of Old Valyria. Viserys was no stranger to getting chopped up by the Iron Throne himself. Throughout his reign, he suffered many minor injuries from the throne's swords. They were the Iron Throne's way of saying he was unworthy, that he was losing his grip on the realm. Eventually, the wounds festered and led to his drawn-out, rotting death. From just this one cut alone, Rhaenyra sees her father's fate playing out before her. She knows her time on the Iron Throne is in peril.

Meanwhile, A similar sequence plays out in George R.R. Martin's Fire and Blood , although it takes place far earlier in Rhaenyra's reign. When she first sits on the Iron Throne in the book, Rhaenyra picks up cuts on her leg and palm and leaves the throne room with blood running down her body for everyone to see. It's visual proof for the realm that the Iron Throne is straight up rejecting her.

Notably, When House of the Dragon initially omitted that detail , I thought it was the show's way of legitimizing Rhaenyra's rule and silencing the "historical" sources in Fire and Blood , who may have embellished her downfall. Now, though, it's clear that the show was just taking a longer approach to Rhaenyra's decline as a ruler. Instead of immediately shunning her, the show's version of the Iron Throne must have thought, "You know what? I'm gonna give her some time to prove herself." When that didn't work out, it decided it was time to give her a very painful wake-up call by turning her hand into mincemeat.

As per the latest buzz, The cut is still small enough that Rhaenyra is able to keep it private, unlike in Fire and Blood , where it's a public affair. Still, as Rhaenyra keeps unravelling, could the Iron Throne keep doing more visible damage until, like Viserys, Rhaenyra's unworthiness is visible to everyone?

In further updates, More importantly, what are the Iron Throne's criteria for a good ruler? Because it certainly wasn't slicing and dicing Aegon II (Tom Glynn-Carney) while he sat — unworthily! — on the Iron Throne. Nor did it chop up the tyrannical Joffrey Baratheon when he was king. Did the Iron Throne get lazy, or is a non-sentient chair of swords just maybe not the best judge of a monarch?
On top of that, House of the Dragon Season 3 is now streaming on HBO Max, with new episodes premiering Sundays at 9 p.m. ET on HBO and HBO Max.

Now, next-gen Pulsar 125 has reached showrooms and we can expect other Pulsar models to follow a similar pattern before they’re officially launched on August 12th launch.

Adding to this, There’s a recurring pattern of unreleased Bajaj vehicles reaching showrooms before a formal launch and the latest recipient is 2027 Bajaj Pulsar 125. This looks like an update to Classic Pulsar 125, which was updated in January 2026. Within a short period of time, updating a mass-market offering is an unusual practice in the industry.

Meanwhile, Next-gen Pulsar 125 packs an evolved design over the current Classic Pulsar 125 with a much sharper and more aggressive LED headlights. The current headlight was introduced in January 2026 and was complemented by LED blinkers. Those LED blinkers are missing in next-gen Pulsar 125, for some reason, replaced by halogen units.

Notably, Fuel tank looks more or less identical to current model and the model from two decades ago, but tank shrouds have been redesigned to be pointier, more angular and aggressive. This is the first-ever tail light update to Classic Pulsar lineup since the UG3 update in 2006. These new revised LED tail lights look sporty and modern.

As per the latest buzz, The particular variant we see in the spy shots, look like a base variant which has a single-piece seat and a single-piece rear grab rail. Maybe a higher variant with split seats, belly pan, split grab rail and probably LED blinkers (all these verified in spy shot) is part of the equation. The Colour LCD screen, which is much bigger in size, might be standard and it seems to get turn-by-turn navigation too.

In further updates, The exhaust seems to be new as well and is not cylindrical in shape. It looks slightly larger than current model as well. There are new side body panels with next-gen Bajaj Pulsar 125 and some of the main frame, finished in Silver, is now exposed and is part of the bike’s design. Clip-on handlebars along with hinged fuel filler cap continue as they were.

On top of that, Looking at the leaked motorcycle, one can’t help but think about the now-discontinued Pulsar N125 , sales of which lasted for around 2 years. We say this because this next-gen Pulsar 125 is packing a rear mono-shock suspension, which none of the Classic Pulsars ever got. So, there may be a new main frame and subframe to accommodate this rear mono-shock.

Wheels look like they’re identical to current model and then we have front disc brakes and rear drum brakes. The engine could be carried forward from the current Classic Pulsar 125, which is a 124.38cc single-cylinder air-cooled unit with 11.8 PS and 10.8 Nm, mated to a 5-speed gearbox. Fuel tank could be the same 15L in capacity, which is more than what fancy ADV Tourers offer these days.

title: Avengers: Doomsday’s First Look At Sentry Costume Confirms What We All Suspected
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

LEGO officially unveiled its first wave of buildable sets for Avengers: Doomsday , which includes "New Avengers Tower," which first appeared in Thunderbolts* . The soon-to-release set (which launches on October 4) features the first-ever Sentry minifigure, unveiling his official costume for the looming Multiversal conflict.

Adding to this, Like most of Doomsday 's cast with recent MCU appearances, Sentry doesn't seem to be getting a new superhero set for his soon-to-release 2026 return. At least based on his LEGO figure, Sentry is still in the same suit from Thunderbolts* that was designed by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine with a rather corporate, PR-driven look.

Meanwhile, Followers already got their first look at Bob's comeback in the Thunderbolts* post-credits scene, which is ripped straight from Doomsday 's first act. At that time, Bob hadn't suited up as Sentry in 14 months, but Avengers 5 's latest LEGO wave unsurprisingly confirms that, yes, he will get back in the yellow and blue.

Notably, Doomsday 's first trailer seemingly unveiled the moments that immediately follow the Thunderbolts* post-credits scene, with Sentry still firmly on the sidelines to avoid any Void-related risks. The New Avengers, including Bob, were spotted meeting with Thor, Ant-Man, Captain America, and the Fantastic Four as the God of Thunder delivered his rousing speech about the looming threat .

As per the latest buzz, While Doomsday 's trailer hid the Sentry away for now, LEGO is showing no such restraint, seemingly depicting the New Avengers (and the Fantastic Four's Human Torch) fighting Robert Downey Jr.'s Doctor Doom around the New York skyscraper.

In further updates, Even before transforming into the Void, Sentry proves to be an all-powerful force in Thunderbolts* , with superstrength, superspeed, superhuman durability, flight, and the ability to manipulate the world around him in various ways. Still, he was missing his devastating golden energy with the power of a million exploding suns from the comics, although that seems to be on full display in Doomsday .

On top of that, Insider Daniel Richtman previously declared that Lewis Pullman's Sentry will be among the MVPs of Avengers: Doomsday . Whenever Bob is eventually forced to come off the sidelines and exhibit his immense power, it seems he will have a major impact and could turn the tide of the coming conflict.

But there have been signs that Sentry's second arc will run deeper than just a few aura-fueled moments, and may carry some real emotional weight. Last year, a Doomsday set leak hinted at a visit to Bob's mother's home , where audiences may learn more about his troubled upbringing as a child of domestic abuse.

The key is not to get confrontational, if you can avoid it — but to focus on connection instead. Other people’s feelings are every bit as real and important as your own, and the more you keep that in mind, the happier your relationships will become.

In further updates, You’re forthright by nature; you’re not afraid to speak up, even when you suspect your opinions might be a bit controversial. And because straightforwardness comes so naturally to you, you tend to assume that others will be honest with you about what they think, too. But far more often, the idea that everything is a competition is an illusion — one that only hurts you and the people in your life. This week, especially, try to operate from the assumption that there’s a way for everyone to win.

You see other people saving lives and tackling the world’s great problems, and you imagine that this is where you should be directing your energy, too. Don’t give into this reductive thinking. Right now, it’s best to prioritize whatever you’re genuinely enthusiastic about. Everyone has their own unique gifts and passions. Focus on yours.

body: Here's what's trending across India right now:

Adding to this, facebook --> twitter --> whatsup --> linkded --> email MORE (3) Messenger Whatsapp --> KARACHI: Police are continuing their investigation into the murder of Mir Raza Ali, a young resident of PECHS and a student-entrepreneur, whose body was found in Gulistan-e-Jauhar earlier this week.

Meanwhile, According to officials, the victim had left his residence on the night between Tuesday and Wednesday, using an online taxi service and went missing shortly afterwards. His body was discovered on Wednesday in a hilly area of Gulistan-e-Jauhar Block 1.

Notably, District East police, along with the Crime Scene Unit, visited the site and surrounding areas to collect evidence. They recovered the victim's iPhone from around 200 metres away from the crime scene, near the Naseer Tower apartments. The device is password-protected, and efforts are underway to unlock it.

As per the latest buzz, Police also found a pistol pouch at the crime scene, which investigators suspect may be linked to the weapon used in the murder. Search operations in nearby bushes are ongoing to recover further evidence, including the firearm.

In further updates, Investigators have obtained the victim's call data record (CDR) and are examining more than 50 associated phone numbers. Officials shared that a route map is being developed with the help of the CDR, while CCTV footage from various locations is also being reviewed. Police claim that more than half of the case has been traced through mobile data analysis.

On top of that, Statements have been recorded from the online taxi driver, the victim's business partner, and other individuals connected to the case. Police have also summoned the victim's fiancée for questioning.

Police Surgeon Dr Samia Syed shared the body showed no signs of torture or burning. She verified that the victim was killed by a single gunshot to the chest, with the bullet exiting from the back. The body had begun to decompose, and blood samples from the victim's clothes have been sent for chemical analysis.

title: Drifting SpaceX rocket heading for accidental collision with moon
body: Here's what's trending across India right now:
Prefer the Guardian on Google A drifting SpaceX rocket is on a collision course with the moon after launching a pair of lunar landers more than a year ago.

Adding to this, The rocket’s upper stage will unintentionally slam into the moon on Wednesday, carving out a crater and sending up a plume of dust and rubble that scientists – and sky gazers – are eager to observe.

Meanwhile, Space tracking expert Bill Gray predicts an impact of 5,400mph (8,700km/h) – seven times the speed of sound – near Einstein Crater on the moon’s sunlit western limb. With the action unfolding in the wee hours of the morning for the US, the eastern portions of the US and Canada, and much of South America, should have the best views.
Notably, While scientists are not too concerned about this particular piece of space junk , it highlights the growing threat as more and more items cram into orbit.
As per the latest buzz, It was never SpaceX’s intent to hit the moon. But space experts shared the crash could have been avoided if the upper stage had been nudged into orbit around the sun.
In further updates, It will be the second dead rocket known to crash into the moon accidentally. A Chinese rocket segment dug out a pair of craters on the lunar far side in 2022.
On top of that, The new smashup will occur on the moon’s near side, packing the equivalent energy of three tons of TNT explosives.

The impact flash, lasting less than a second, will probably be too dim to see from Earth, according to experts. But the stream of ejected material could stretch for several miles into space and remain visible to telescopes for tens of minutes.

title: Hrithik Roshan leases Andheri West office space for Rs. 17 lakh per month; five-year deal registered
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The commercial property spans nearly 6,000 sq. ft. in Lotus Nilkamal Business Park and adds another income-generating asset to the star's real estate portfolio.

Adding to this, The office premises are located in Lotus Nilkamal Business Park on New Link Road and comprise seven units situated on a higher floor of the commercial building. The total built-up area of the leased property is close to 6,000 sq. ft. and also includes seven dedicated car parking spaces. As per the documents, the lease agreement was registered on June 29, 2026, while the tenancy has been effective from April 1, 2026. The agreement is valid for five years and will continue until March 31, 2031.

Meanwhile, The financial terms of the lease indicate that Clearsynth Labs Limited will pay a monthly rent of Rs. 17 lakh during the initial three years of the agreement, covering the period from April 1, 2026, to March 31, 2029. Thereafter, the rent will be revised upwards to Rs. 19.55 lakh per month for the remaining two years, from April 1, 2029, to March 31, 2031. The documents further reveal that the tenant has deposited a security amount of Rs. 68 lakh as part of the agreement.

Notably, The latest transaction further expands Hrithik Roshan's portfolio of income-generating commercial assets. Over the past few years, the star has been actively involved in strategic real estate investments across Mumbai.

As per the latest buzz, In 2025, property documents accessed by Zapkey had opened up that Hrithik leased his sea-facing luxury residence in Juhu to his girlfriend, Saba Grewal (Azad), for a monthly rent of Rs. 75,000 under a one-year agreement.

In further updates, Separately, the star also made headlines last year for a major commercial property acquisition. According to property registration documents accessed by Propstack, Hrithik Roshan, along with his father Rakesh Roshan's HRX Digitech LLP and his mother Pramila Roshan's Filmkunj (Bombay) Pvt Ltd, acquired 10 commercial office units in Andheri West for approximately Rs. 28 crores.

On top of that, With the latest lease transaction, the star continues to strengthen his presence in Mumbai's commercial real estate market. The Andheri West property is expected to generate a steady rental income over the next five years, reflecting the growing trend of celebrities investing in commercial assets alongside their work in the entertainment industry.

title: Sunny Deol to honour real-life changemakers during Batwara 1947 promotional tour across India: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
A source says the star will felicitate citizens who have made a meaningful contribution to society as part of the movie's nationwide promotions.

Adding to this, Directed by Rajkumar Santoshi and produced under the banner of Aamir Khan Productions, Batwara 1947 stars Shabana Azmi, Sunny Deol and Preity G Zinta in leading roles. Set against the backdrop of the Partition of India, the movie explores the human stories that emerged during one of the most defining moments in the subcontinent's history.

Meanwhile, According to a source associated with the project, the promotional campaign will go beyond conventional movie events by recognising real-life changemakers in every city the team visits. “Makers has planned a very special initiative during the Batwara 1947 promotional city tour. In every city, Sunny Deol will honour and felicitate citizens who went beyond their moral duty and made a meaningful difference to society. Through this gesture, Makers wants the movie’s journey to celebrate real-life courage and compassion,” added the source.

Notably, While the makers have not officially revealed further details about the initiative, it is expected to be incorporated into the movie's promotional events across the country. The gesture is shared to align with the movie's themes of humanity, resilience and compassion during times of conflict.

As per the latest buzz, The of late rolled out trailer has offered audiences a glimpse into the emotional narrative of Batwara 1947 , depicting the impact of Partition through the experiences of its characters. The movie aims to explore not only the tragedy associated with the historical event but also the stories of individuals who displayed courage and empathy amid extraordinary circumstances.

In further updates, The movie features an ensemble cast including Shabana Azmi, Sunny Deol, Preity G Zinta, Karan Deol, Ali Fazal and Abhimanyu Singh. It also marks the reunion of Sunny Deol and director Rajkumar Santoshi, who previously collaborated on films such as Ghayal , Damini and Ghatak .

On top of that, Produced by Aamir Khan and Aparna Purohit, Batwara 1947 features music composed by A. R. Rahman, with lyrics penned by Javed Akhtar. The period drama is scheduled for a worldwide theatrical rollout on August 14, 2026, coinciding with India's Independence Day celebrations.

As the nationwide promotional tour gathers momentum, the reported initiative to recognise citizens making a positive impact could add a distinctive element to the campaign, while reinforcing the movie's central themes of courage, compassion and hope.

title: Sonam Wangchuk's wife takes a swipe at Bollywood while praising The Odyssey: ‘Need to rediscover its role’
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:

Activist Sonam Wangchuk's wife and social entrepreneur Gitanjali Angmo of late lauded Christopher Nolan's latest movie, The Odyssey. She also recalled meeting the acclaimed filmmaker in 2024 and shared a photo with him. However, while appreciating The Odyssey, she also shared her views on Bollywood, which many may interpret as a subtle jibe at the Hindi movie industry.

Adding to this, Sonam Wangchuk's wife Gitanjali Angmo takes a dig at Bollywood. What did Gitanjali Angmo write? Gitanjali gushed over The Odyssey and described watching the movie on the big screen as a "surreal" experience. She wrote, "Watched Odyssey yesterday. Surreal to see on screen what was still a conversation when I accidentally met Christopher Nolan in New York in 2024. Its themes feel so familiar to the Indian imagination: the hero’s journey, dharma and destiny, exile, temptation, homecoming, the human being tested and transformed along the way."

Meanwhile, Sharing her thoughts on Bollywood, she wrote, "India is sitting on a treasure-house of such epics. Imagine bringing them to cinema with scale, sensitivity and intellectual depth. Cinema is more than entertainment. It shapes minds. Perhaps Bollywood needs to rediscover its role as one of our most powerful classrooms."

Notably, Last month, when Sonam Wangchuk was on a hunger strike at Delhi's Jantar Mantar demanding the resignation of Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, along with reforms and accountability in India's examination system following the NEET paper leak, many expected Aamir Khan to support the activist. Many believed that his smash hit movie 3 Idiots was based on Wangchuk's life, especially after 3 Idiots star Omi Vaidya, who played Chatur in the movie, spoke in favour of Wangchuk.

As per the latest buzz, However, during an interaction at the British Movie Institute (BFI), Aamir denied knowing the activist during the making of 3 Idiots. He shared, “No, that’s not true, actually. That is a misconception. I didn’t know about Mr Sonam Wangchuk at that time when we were doing the movie. I know that, I saw a video of Chatur, just of late he shared that… No, he’s wrong. Maybe that’s what Chatur was thinking but I want to tell you neither did Raju, nor Abhijat (one of the two writers), nor I, we didn’t know about Sonam. However, what Mr Sonam is doing is good work anyway. He doesn’t need to be based on the character of 3 Idiots for us to respect him and the work he’s done."

In further updates, After Aamir's statement, a video of the star meeting Wangchuk in 2008, a year before the rollout of 3 Idiots, went widely shared. Following this, many followers questioned the superstar's statement, while others criticised him for not supporting Wangchuk's movement.

On top of that, For the unversed, Wangchuk ended his 26-day hunger strike on July 23–24, 2026, after meeting Union Ministers J.P. Nadda and other government representatives. A few days later, Dharmendra Pradhan resigned as India's Union Minister for Education on July 25, 2026.
